fact_sources.fact: Airbnb is reimagining the Raichand House from Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham (K3G) in Mumbai for the film's 25th anniversary ('At Home with the Raichands', an Only on Airbnb experience)
Booking requests open 23 Nov 2026 at 12 PM IST (Airbnb: at airbnb.com/k3g; afaqs: through Airbnb's website)
Guests welcomed in Mumbai 1-6 December 2026; two-hour experience
'Each spot covers one guest plus one companion, for 180 guests in total' (Airbnb); afaqs: 180 invitations
Not a competition; must have an active Airbnb profile with a history of positive reviews; government-issued ID required
Guests responsible for their own travel to and from Mumbai
Grand staircase, family study and Poo's closet; immersive audio tour of the film's moments
The experience does not include the appearance of Karan, Poo or Rohan (the film's stars won't be there in person)

notes: Airbnb also bills Karan, Poo and Rohan as hosts; afaqs notes the same conflict. Slides use only character names as Airbnb does and say 'the film's stars won't be there in person'. 23 Nov 2026 is a Monday. Note: idly #3125's text says Karan Johar, Hrithik Roshan and Kareena Kapoor 'will host the experience'; Airbnb's page says the experience does not include their appearance (afaqs flags the conflict). The card follows Airbnb.
